mergeBackMsg: Merge the isolated worktree's changes back into the main directory. The main directory must be clean (no uncommitted changes), or the merge will be rejected.
promoteMsg: Promote the isolated copy to a real branch ({branch} → mj/ prefix) and remove the worktree. Changes stay on the branch, ready to merge or push yourself.
removeMsg: Remove the isolated worktree. Changes that were neither merged nor promoted will be lost for good. Clean up anyway?
mergedBackMsg: Merged back into the main directory
label: Isolated worktree: {name}
hint: Changes stay out of the main directory; wrap up when the task is done:
mergeBackHint: Merge the worktree's changes back into the main directory
promoteHint: Promote to a real branch (mj/ prefix) and remove the worktree
removeHint: Remove the isolated worktree (unmerged changes will be lost)
branchTitle: Pick the task's base branch (nothing switches until you send)
branchRenderLimitHint: Showing the first {count} branches; search to narrow down
noRemote: No remote configured; listing local branches only
initGitHint: Initialize a Git repository to enable Worktree
enableHint: When enabled, a separate workspace is created from the selected branch for the task, so files in the original working directory are left untouched.
createFailedFallback: Failed to create the worktree; the task runs as a normal task.

branchSwitch.title: Switch branch
branchSwitch.desc: {folder} currently belongs to branch {current}. This task selected branch {selected}. Confirming will switch the branch and create the task.
branchSwitch.dirtyBlocked: The workspace has uncommitted changes, so the branch cannot be switched. Handle them first and retry.
branchSwitch.gitIdentityMissing: Git author identity is not configured. Set user.name and user.email, or choose Stash and retry.
branchSwitch.failed: Failed to switch branch. Please retry.

dirty.desc: {folder} currently belongs to branch {current} and has uncommitted changes. Pick how to handle them; the task will then switch to {selected} and be created.

branchLocked: This task already runs in an isolated copy — its base was fixed at creation time. Merge or clean up the copy above before changing the base.
countWarning: Worktree task workspaces are close to the limit ({count}/{cleanupLimit}). Clean up idle tasks to free space before creating more.

limit.sendDisabledTooltip: You have reached the Worktree workspace limit. Clean up idle worktrees before using it again.

cleanup.title: Task workspace limit reached
cleanup.description: You already have {count} task workspaces (worktrees), which is the limit, so Worktree cannot be used for new tasks. Choose a cleanup scope.
cleanup.result: Cleaned {cleaned} worktree(s); skipped {dirty} dirty and {recent} not-yet-old.
cleanup.done: Cleaned {cleaned}; skipped {dirty} and {recent} not yet old enough.
cleanup.deleteThreads: Also archive the conversations that used these copies
cleanup.deleteThreadsHint: Off by default: a copy is a cache, the conversation history is not. Archived conversations can be restored.
cleanup.threadsArchiveFailed: Copies were cleaned up, but archiving the related conversations failed

copyMissing: This conversation's working directory (isolated copy) has been cleaned up: {path}
